description: Plain CSV files built to tempt false automatic matches: near-identical references, a reference reused a year later, a credit note numbered like an invoice, identical amounts in crossed order, ambiguous candidates, generic references, a decimal error and a duplicate on the statement.

notes.statement 7: Two ledger lines can be INV-5001: the engine must not choose.
